title: Cobblemon: Mega Showdown
description: Adds Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Teralization, Dyna/Gigantamax, Ultra Burst & Fusions to Cobblemon!
body:
![banner1](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_6488e172-95fe-46d0-b211-c47ba4ba1b76.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_b45b4497-b99b-478b-bb78-816ecf83e727.png) ![banner2](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_4bd2641e-5eea-4372-ad16-c23019a5a43e.png) ![banner3](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_4b74b831-b235-42c6-ab80-34dd9c3f2ce1.png) ![banner4](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_a2e4b377-84ff-4037-8f79-7e1a07b626ec.png) ![banner5](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_97ed6f11-026f-449b-97ee-86e1500c2794.png)

Create your own Megas, Items & much more!

Mega Showdown acts as a modding platform that allows you to datapack almost everything you could think of! We have our own [📖 Wiki](https://github.com/yajatkaul/CobblemonMegaShowdown/wiki) for addon creators and it features almost everything you can do with MSD - including: Custom Megas, Gmax, Fusions, and general Form Changes Custom Showdown items, including held form changes Custom Status effects, Conditions or weathers Custom Showdown/Battle scripts And much more!
![banner6](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_97ed6f11-026f-449b-97ee-86e1500c2794.png)

Accessories Integration!

All Mega Showdown Gimmick items are able to be worn in their own Gimmick slots, no need to decide between all the accessories mods you installed! ![banner7](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_b8f1e56c-7f90-47dd-948c-e096d5b53918.png)
![banner8](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_231b647f-88e3-485a-b07f-1ed063068956.png)

General Features!

Lots of Datapackable features Cosmetic items support Accessories support All fusion Pokémon All form changes Riding support All 90+ Megas All Gimmicks
![banner9](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_97ed6f11-026f-449b-97ee-86e1500c2794.png)

Credits

Credits for all our lovely Contributors and info on who's models we use for the mod are listed 👉 [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VPRia2W_7wqhbwSGv1845qmXw_FtjZ4FDhr58fRZFSM/edit?usp=sharing)
![banner10](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_97ed6f11-026f-449b-97ee-86e1500c2794.png)

Incompatibilities

Most known incompatible addons, datapacks and mods can be found 👉 [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pVLaT_dkQnQ2oO1IrJwf0RzkZNgqds2RMlYYOtqBVGg/edit?usp=sharing)
![banner11](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1189523/description_97ed6f11-026f-449b-97ee-86e1500c2794.png)
